text: God gives me favor with authority figures — His hand opens every door.
bibleVerseText: And because the gracious hand of my God was on me, the king granted my requests.

text: God makes me skilled in His word and I walk confidently in it.
bibleVerseText: This Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a teacher well versed in the Law of Moses, which the Lord, the God of Israel, had given.

text: God's favor rests upon me powerfully — His grace is my covering.
bibleVerseText: The gracious hand of our God is on everyone who looks to him, but his great anger is against all who forsake him.

text: God guides me when I seek His direction.
bibleVerseText: There, by the Ahava Canal, I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.

text: God's protection surrounds me on every journey — I travel in His care.
bibleVerseText: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and he answered our prayer.

text: God makes me a faithful steward of His resources.
bibleVerseText: I weighed out to them the offering of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his advisers, his officials and all Israel present there had donated for the house of our God.

text: God restores everything I have lost and fills my heart with joy.
bibleVerseText: But many of the older priests and Levites and family heads, who had seen the former temple, wept aloud when they saw the foundation of this temple being laid, while many others shouted for joy.

text: God's restoration in my life brings me to tears of joy.
bibleVerseText: No one could distinguish the sound of the shouts of joy from the sound of weeping, because the people made so much noise. And the sound was heard far away.

text: God helps me finish what He started despite every opposition.
bibleVerseText: So the elders of the Jews continued to build and prosper under the preaching of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah, a descendant of Iddo. They finished building the temple according to the command of the God of Israel.

text: God's work in my life brings great celebration.
bibleVerseText: Then the people of Israel the priests, the Levites and the rest of the exiles celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.

text: God fills me with joy as I remember His deliverance.
bibleVerseText: For seven days they celebrated with joy the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because the Lord had filled them with joy by changing the attitude of the king of Assyria so that he assisted them in the work on the house of God, the God of Israel.

text: God uses me to teach His truth to others.
bibleVerseText: For Ezra had devoted himself to the study and observance of the Law of the Lord, and to teaching its decrees and laws in Israel.

text: God's justice prevails in every situation — no wrong against me stands.
bibleVerseText: Whoever does not obey the law of your God and the law of the king must surely be punished by death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment.

text: God's word leads me into righteousness and I walk in His ways.
bibleVerseText: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me because of this unfaithfulness of the exiles.

text: God preserves a remnant and gives me a future full of hope.
bibleVerseText: But now, for a brief moment, the Lord our God has been gracious in leaving us a remnant and giving us a firm place in his sanctuary, and so our God gives light to our eyes and a little relief in our bondage.

text: God leads me away from everything that dishonors His name.
bibleVerseText: Now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all these women and their children, in accordance with the counsel of my lord and of those who fear the commands of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.

text: No obstacle stops God's work in my life.
bibleVerseText: But there are many people here and it is the rainy season; so we cannot stand outside. Besides, this matter cannot be taken care of in a day or two, because we have sinned greatly in this thing.

text: The Lord moves the hearts of others to fulfill His purpose in my life.
bibleVerseText: The Lord moved the heart of Cyrus king of Persia to make a proclamation.

text: God's good hand is upon me — His strength is my confidence.
bibleVerseText: Because the hand of the Lord my God was on me, I took courage.

text: God's word is planted in my heart and I walk in it with joy.
bibleVerseText: For Ezra had devoted himself to the study and observance of the Law of the Lord, and to teaching its decrees and laws in Israel.

text: God grants me favor with those in power — He opens doors no man can shut.
bibleVerseText: Praise be to the Lord, the God of our ancestors, who has put it into the king's heart to bring honor to the house of the Lord in Jerusalem.

text: God rebuilds through me what was destroyed — every broken thing is restored.
bibleVerseText: Then they gave money to the masons and carpenters, and gave food and drink and olive oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre, so that they would bring cedar logs by sea from Lebanon to Joppa.

text: Great joy fills my heart as God restores everything that was taken.
bibleVerseText: And all the people gave a great shout of praise to the Lord, because the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid.

text: God has set me apart for holiness and I live consecrated to Him.
bibleVerseText: Separate yourselves from the peoples around you and from your foreign wives.

text: The Lord's steadfast love endures forever — I am held in it completely.
bibleVerseText: With praise and thanksgiving they sang to the Lord: 'He is good; his love toward Israel endures forever.'

text: God comforts me in every season of loss.
bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.

text: God satisfies my deep hunger and thirst for righteousness — He fills me completely.
bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.

text: God shows me mercy as I show mercy to others.
bibleVerseText: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.

text: I guard my heart so nothing blurs my view of God.
bibleVerseText: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

text: I am a peacemaker and God calls me His child.
bibleVerseText: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

text: My persecution for the name of Jesus brings great reward in heaven — I rejoice.
bibleVerseText: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

text: I overcome evil with love and prayer.
bibleVerseText: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, that you may be children of your Father in heaven.

text: My forgiveness of others releases God's forgiveness over me — I cancel debts freely because God canceled mine completely.
bibleVerseText: Forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.

text: I live free from anxiety about the future — I do not worry about tomorrow.
bibleVerseText: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.

text: I show grace instead of judgment.
bibleVerseText: Do not judge, or you too will be judged. For in the same way you judge others, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.

text: I live by every word that comes from the mouth of God.
bibleVerseText: Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.

text: Christ makes me salt and light in this world.
bibleVerseText: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again? You are the light of the world.

text: I seek God's kingdom first and everything I need is added to me.
bibleVerseText: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

text: I ask and receive, I seek and find, I knock and doors open.
bibleVerseText: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.

text: My faith moves mountains — I refuse to accept impossibility as a final answer.
bibleVerseText: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

text: Jesus holds all authority in heaven and on earth — and He is always with me.
bibleVerseText: Then Jesus came to them and said, 'All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.'

text: Jesus is with me always, to the very end of the age.
bibleVerseText: And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.

text: I have been given authority in Jesus' name over every demonic force.
bibleVerseText: He said to them, 'I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven. I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy.'

text: I speak with heaven's language — the Spirit gives me words to declare truth and pray powerfully.
bibleVerseText: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues.

text: I am protected from every harmful thing.
bibleVerseText: They will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all.

text: I carry the Gospel to everyone I meet.
bibleVerseText: He said to them, 'Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.'

text: The Lord works with me and confirms His word with signs following.
bibleVerseText: Then the disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and confirmed his word by the signs that accompanied it.

text: God gives me a hundredfold return on everything I gave up to follow Jesus.
bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for me and the gospel will fail to receive a hundred times as much in this present age.

text: I follow Jesus freely — He leads me and I go without hesitation.
bibleVerseText: Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.

text: I find true life by yielding to Jesus — His plans are better than mine.
bibleVerseText: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me and for the gospel will save it.

text: My soul is worth more than the whole world — nothing compares to what God placed in me.
bibleVerseText: What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul? Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?

text: I proclaim Jesus boldly even when it costs me something real.
bibleVerseText: If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father's glory with the holy angels.

text: My greatness comes through serving — the greatest among God's people is the servant of all.
bibleVerseText: Anyone who wants to be first must be the very last, and the servant of all.

text: I welcome Jesus by serving the vulnerable and the least.
bibleVerseText: Whoever welcomes one of these little children in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me does not welcome me but the one who sent me.

text: God frees me from everything that once held me back from walking with Him.
bibleVerseText: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life maimed than with two hands to go into hell.

text: God refines me like fire — burning away what is false.
bibleVerseText: Everyone will be salted with fire. Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can you make it salty again?

text: God makes me salt of the earth — preserving truth, adding flavor, and carrying peace into every room I enter.
bibleVerseText: Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with each other.

text: I lay hands on the sick in Jesus' name and they recover.
bibleVerseText: They will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well.

text: The kingdom of God lives within me by the Holy Spirit.
bibleVerseText: The kingdom of God is in your midst.

text: I am not ashamed of Jesus — I stand boldly for His name in every place.
bibleVerseText: If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father's glory with the holy angels.

text: I am a new wineskin ready for new wine.
bibleVerseText: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins.

text: With God, nothing is impossible — every circumstance bows to this truth.
bibleVerseText: With man this is impossible, but not with God; all things are possible with God.

text: I speak to the storms in my life as Jesus did — Peace, be still.
bibleVerseText: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, 'Quiet! Be still!' Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.

text: God blesses me beyond what I can contain — His overflow is my portion.
bibleVerseText: Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you will bear!

text: God's covenant love extends to me from generation to generation.
bibleVerseText: His mercy extends to those who fear him, from generation to generation.

text: God satisfies my hunger for Him completely.
bibleVerseText: He has filled the hungry with good things but has sent the rich away empty.

text: God's salvation transforms my entire household — what He does in me reaches every person under my roof.
bibleVerseText: Jesus said to him, 'Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.'

text: Jesus uses me to seek out and rescue the lost.
bibleVerseText: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.

text: Jesus has full authority to forgive all my sins.
bibleVerseText: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.

text: God anoints me to bring good news to the poor, freedom to the captive.
bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor.

text: I declare freedom to every captive soul.
bibleVerseText: He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to set the oppressed free.

text: This is my year of the Lord's favor.
bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to set the oppressed free, to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor.

text: God's promises are being fulfilled in my life today.
bibleVerseText: He began by saying to them, 'Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.'

text: When I am persecuted for Jesus, I rejoice — my reward in heaven is great.
bibleVerseText: Blessed are you when people hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man.

text: God rewards my faithfulness — because I have been faithful with little.
bibleVerseText: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven.

text: God rewards my generous giving — the measure I give is the measure that returns.
bibleVerseText: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great.

text: Nothing is impossible with God in my family, body, finances, or story.
bibleVerseText: For no word from God will ever fail.

text: The power of the Most High overshadows me — I am covered, consecrated, and protected by His glory and presence.
bibleVerseText: The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you.

text: My spirit rejoices in God my Savior.
bibleVerseText: My soul glorifies the Lord and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior.

text: The Lord has done great things for me and I am filled with joy.
bibleVerseText: The Mighty One has done great things for me holy is his name.

text: I am blessed because I believe — faith activated the promise.
bibleVerseText: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord would fulfill his promises to her!

text: I give, and it is given back to me.
bibleVerseText: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap.

text: I have authority to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy.
bibleVerseText: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you.

text: My name is written in heaven — and that is the greatest reason to celebrate.
bibleVerseText: Rejoice that your names are written in heaven.

text: The kingdom of God lives within me by the Holy Spirit.
bibleVerseText: The kingdom of God is in your midst.

text: I am faithful with little and God trusts me with much more.
bibleVerseText: Whoever is faithful in very little is also faithful in much.

text: I bear much fruit as His disciple and the Father is glorified.
bibleVerseText: This is to my Father's glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.

text: Greater is He in me than he who is in the world.
bibleVerseText: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.
